scripts.dev: npm run migrate:deploy && VITE_MIDDLEWARE=false tsx server.ts
scripts.start: npm run migrate:deploy && VITE_MIDDLEWARE=false tsx server.ts

scriptDescriptions.dev: Applies committed Prisma migrations, then starts the backend API without Vite middleware.
scriptDescriptions.dev:fullstack: Applies committed Prisma migrations, then starts the backend in fullstack mode with default middleware behavior.
scriptDescriptions.start: Production-style backend start: applies committed Prisma migrations first, then boots the API server.
scriptDescriptions.prisma:generate: Regenerates the Prisma client from prisma/schema.postgres.prisma.
scriptDescriptions.prisma:migrate: Runs Prisma migrate dev for interactive local schema development; not recommended against the shared production database.
scriptDescriptions.prisma:deploy: Applies committed Prisma migrations to the configured database.
scriptDescriptions.migrate:deploy: Explicit Prisma migrate deploy command using prisma/schema.postgres.prisma.
scriptDescriptions.migrate:create: Generates a timestamped migration folder by diffing committed migrations against the current Prisma schema.
scriptDescriptions.prisma:seed: Runs the backend seed script to insert or refresh baseline data.
